provider_name.description: Name of the service that generated the statement, e.g. the block explorer or exchange.

provider_email.description: Contact email address of the provider, as printed in the header.

asset.description: Cryptocurrency the statement covers, as printed, e.g. BITCOIN.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address the statement is for, exactly as printed.

statement_period_start.description: First day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

statement_period_end.description: Last day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

balance_summary.description: The balance summary section, exactly as printed. Do not compute or correct the figures.

starting_balance_crypto.description: Starting balance in the cryptocurrency's units.

ending_balance_crypto.description: Ending balance in the cryptocurrency's units.

total_received_crypto.description: Total received during the period, in the cryptocurrency's units.

total_sent_crypto.description: Total sent during the period, in the cryptocurrency's units.

transactions.description: Every row of the transaction history table across all pages, in order.

direction.description: Whether the wallet received or sent the amount.

amount_crypto.description: Amount in the cryptocurrency's units, from the AMOUNT (BTC) column.

amount_usd.description: US dollar value at the time of the transaction, from the AMOUNT (USD) column.

transaction_hash.description: Full transaction hash, joined into one string with no spaces if it wraps over two lines.

generated_at.description: Date and time the statement was generated, as printed in the disclaimer.
